nonblocking_gaps.detail: Persistent ordinary load failure can retry blocking staged IO every drive frame; root logs cause but sets generic road-edge UI status. Gate/pause/backoff and truthful map-load status are advisable before whole-map gameplay claims.

Header accepts arbitrary nonparallel up/forward; vertical forward with valid nonstandard up is rejected by the standard-world-up frustum helper. Current root always uses +Y up, so this is not a current adapter blocker.
